environment.description: Same EKS pod in namespace 'data-plane-hardened'. Calico CNI with a GlobalNetworkPolicy (order: 100) that applies to pods matching label app.kubernetes.io/part-of=data-plane. The policy has a single egress rule with a 'Deny' action for destination CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports. However, the policy uses Calico's 'applyOnForward: true' directive which only affects forwarded traffic through the node, not traffic originating from the pod itself. A separate namespaced Kubernetes NetworkPolicy with spec.egress denying 169.254.169.254/32 is also present but uses ipBlock.except for the /32 within a broader /16 allow. The Envoy sidecar has a local rate limit of 10 req/s on non-allowlisted Host headers. Additionally, an iptables PREROUTING rule on the node redirects metadata requests from pod CIDR to a metadata proxy that requires the X-Forwarded-For header to match the pod's service account token audience.
